scope: data-loader runtime only; no FlightReady v2 or dataset change
observation: The workers=0 feasibility pilot increased training time to 133.6 seconds for one epoch versus 100.7 seconds with workers=2 at batch 32.
justification: The measured in-process loader was slower, so the final common protocol retains the faster preregistered worker count.
status_of_prior_runs: workers=0 pilot excluded; all primary runs use workers=2.
